name: Shanghai Bright Meat Group Co. Ltd. Class A
summary: Operating within China, Shanghai Maling Aquarius Co.,Ltd is a key manufacturer and distributor of a wide array of food products. Its offerings include various meat and processed meat items, as well as canned goods, snack foods, chilled cuts, steaks, and other beef selections. These products are marketed under numerous established brands, notably Merlin, Guanshengyuan, Zhengguanghe, SF, Su Shi, Aisen, Big White Rabbit, Bergamot, Huatuo, and 96858. The company, which originated in 1997, maintains its headquarters in Shanghai, China.
